rows.heading: Learning Outcomes

Explain the functions of the police, courts, and corrections in the United States.

rows.heading: Learning Outcomes

Apply the above in comparative studies of sociocultural systems, and especially to explain observed variation, change and adaptation.

rows.heading: Learning Outcomes

rows.heading: Learning Outcomes
outcomes: Prepare outlines and deliver speeches which demonstrate adaptation to audience and effective use of research, organization, and delivery skills
Manage communication apprehension

rows.heading: Learning Outcomes
outcomes: Identify and explain the function of a variety of specific plant descriptors.
Identify and describe the cultural characteristics of the spring plant list.

rows.heading: Learning Outcomes

rows.heading: Learning Outcomes

rows.heading: Learning Outcomes
